context: User: Normalize names before greeting people: trim surrounding whitespace and use Guest for a blank name. Assistant: I trim the input once and use a fallback so the greeting is never empty.

diffs.patch:
diff --git a/src/greet.ts b/src/greet.ts
--- a/src/greet.ts
+++ b/src/greet.ts
@@ -1,3 +1,4 @@
 export function greet(name: string) {
-  return `Hello ${name}`
+  const displayName = name.trim() || "Guest"
+  return `Hello ${displayName}`
 }
